control.title: Personal data inventory (record of processing)
control.description: Maintain an inventory of personal data processing activities with data categories, purposes, lawful ground, systems, processors, retention and transfers.

implementation_notes: Owned by the Grievance Officer; process documented in the privacy runbook.
evidence_hint: Data inventory export from the DPDP module.
acceptance_criteria: The inventory lists processing activities with purpose, data categories and lawful basis
It was updated within the review period

criteria_coverage.criterion: The inventory lists processing activities with purpose, data categories and lawful basis

requirements.title: Process personal data only on a lawful ground
requirements.guidance: Every processing activity must rely on either consent of the Data Principal or a legitimate use listed in Section 7. Record the ground for each activity in the data inventory.

requirements.title: Accountability for all processing, including by processors
requirements.guidance: The Data Fiduciary remains responsible for compliance for processing it does and processing done on its behalf by Data Processors.

requirements.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
requirements.guidance: Maintain an inventory of information and assets with owners.

requirements.title: Privacy and protection of PII
requirements.guidance: Meet privacy and personal data protection requirements, including DPDP.
